[[Speak with Headmaster Kuju (Necromancer)]] | followed by = [[Little Creatures]] | profession = Necromancer | primary = y | secondary = n }} [[Headmaster Kuju]] sends you off to your first [[necromancer]] instructor, [[Reng Ku]]. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | profession = Necromancer | primary = y | secondary = n }} ===Objectives=== * Search [[Sunqua Vale]] for [[Reng Ku]]. ===Early benefits=== *After accepting this quest, you will receive the following: ** {{skill icon|Deathly Swarm}} ** {{skill icon|Life Siphon}} ** {{skill icon|Vampiric Gaze}} ** [[Starter Truncheon]] ===Reward=== * 100 [[Experience]] * 10 [[Gold]] ==Walkthrough== Simply walk from [[Shing Jea Monastery]] into [[Sunqua Vale]] and speak to [[Reng Ku]] in the north. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Headmaster Kuju :''"Child, I can see that one day you will be a great Necromancer. It will be hard work, but I will be here to help you along the way. You must learn to love Grenth and all he stands for. You must care for each corpse as you would your own child. You must accept Death as an ally, and study your Curses and Diseases with ferver. Do all this, and you will surely achieve your potential."'' :''"My grandson, '''Reng Ku''', will provide your initial training. I trust his enthusiasm for our craft will rub off on you. Look for him out in '''Sunqua Vale'''."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I'm ready to begin. I'll look for Reng Ku. | decline = I'm not ready yet. | ask = You have not located '''Reng Ku''' yet? He said he would wait for you in '''Sunqua Vale'''. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Reng Ku :''"Grandmother sent you, I presume. Welcome to the life of Death."'' ==Notes== * [[Primary profession|Primary]] necromancers would have already received Deadly Swarm, Vampiric Gaze, and the Starter Truncheon from either [[Mantid Hatchlings]] or [[Seek Out Headmaster Kuju]].
